messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"book_code":"4BAR","chapter":2,"verses":[{"chapter":2,"text":"1 And Jeremiah ran and told these things to Baruch, and as they went into the temple of God, Jeremiah tore his clothes and put dust on his head and entered the holy place of God.","verse":1},{"chapter":2,"text":"2 And when Baruch saw him with dust sprinkled on his head and his clothes torn, he cried out in a loud voice, saying: “Father Jeremiah, what are you doing? What sin has the people committed?”","verse":2},{"chapter":2,"text":"3 For whenever the people sinned, Jeremiah would sprinkle dust on his head and would pray for the people until their sin was forgiven.","verse":3},{"chapter":2,"text":"4 So Baruch asked him, saying: “Father, what is this?”","verse":4},{"chapter":2,"text":"5 And Jeremiah said to him: “Let us stop tearing our clothes and tear our hearts instead! And let us stop drawing water for the troughs, but let us weep and fill them with tears! For the Lord will not have mercy on this people.”","verse":5}]}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 1,2,3,4,5 in this chapter.
